budget.per_candidate_evaluation_cap: 2 ordinary suites + 3 targeted suites + current behavior panel + previous panel for descendant trace; identical all arms
budget.basis: Engineering follow-up: eight paired seeds improve on the prior three, sixteen attempts allow feedback descendants; neither number is literature-optimal or a power guarantee

feedback.common: One elite parent's code/objective, previous attempt scalar validity/objective; fixed generation policy and selection by dev_train only
feedback.scalar: Identical shadow forecast call; never expose forecast, probe outcome or targeted outcome to generator
feedback.passive: Ordinary concise prospective explanation and common forecast fields are recycled; instrumented B, not numerically interchangeable with v7 B
feedback.behavior_grounded: Same forecast tasks and token cap; require exact code evidence and claim-to-behavior-to-target-condition explanation
feedback.observed_behavior_and_target_outcomes: diagnostics only, never enter generation context, question stack, parent selection, or analyst context
feedback.history: disabled; no frozen history or abstract hints retrieved

measurement.behavior: Predict actual code-returned node on six labeled numeric intervention states, not an optimal action; family-balanced accuracy, missing and invalid execution count wrong in ITT, conditional score separate
measurement.target_failure: candidate invalid on family OR (parent_objective-candidate_objective)/abs(parent_objective) < -1e-9; ties are nonfailures
measurement.target_brier: failure probability versus frozen targeted-family outcome; missing probability OR unscorable valid-child/invalid-parent comparison has worst-case ITT loss1, reported as penalized diagnostic loss not an ordinary Brier observation; missing labels/probabilities remain null and excluded from conditional Brier/calibration; coverage always reported
measurement.calibration: five fixed equal-width bins; discrimination/ECE eligible only with at least ten cases in each class; Brier still descriptive when unbalanced
measurement.potential: step-integrated incumbent improvement over all sixteen allocated slots; no future credit; malformed forecast never suppresses code evaluation
measurement.heldout: all cell incumbents frozen before any heldout evaluation; no reranking or updates afterward
measurement.common_code_panel: six declared external_teacher diagnostic programs x three independent diagnostic seeds x B/C; no panel result or program enters search; avoids inferring analysis ability from different endogenous program distributions
measurement.descendant_chain: source forecast -> exact feedback exposure -> generated child; stricter supported trace additionally requires direct parent link, correct source choice forecast, predicted changed choice on same source panel, positive dev gain and positive targeted gain; counts are trace consistency, not mediation proof

interpretation_gate.primary_comparison: C versus B; B versus A secondary
interpretation_gate.integrity: all24searchcells complete; all36commoncodeforecasts attempted; source/prompt/suite/journal identities intact; no heldout leakage
interpretation_gate.behavior_signal: paired common-code diagnostic mean accuracy improvement at least 0.05; per-code and seed summaries reported
interpretation_gate.target_signal: paired seed median targeted ITT Brier-loss reduction >0, target-label coverage >=0.90 in both B/C, and valid calibration scope disclosed
interpretation_gate.search_signal: paired seed median Potential-AUC C-B >0 with at least6of8 positive; heldout paired median >=0; valid-candidate rate drop no worse than5percentagepoints
interpretation_gate.chain_signal: at least3 strict supported descendant traces from at least2 C cells
interpretation_gate.scope: All thresholds are advance engineering continuation rules, NOT statistical significance or a confirmed paper claim. Report paired uncertainty and every negative/zero/invalid result; do not add runs to pass a gate.
